title: Fix Test Event Detection for All Languages and Frameworks
description: Test events are not correctly identified when agents run tests via terminal commands. Commands like `go test`, `pytest`, `npm test`, `cargo test` etc. are emitted as `agent.tool.terminal.starting` instead of `agent.tool.test.starting`. Fix `classifyCommandKind` to detect all test runner binaries and compound commands across all major languages and frameworks. Also extend `extractTestStartingFromInput` to parse test filters and timeouts from terminal command strings. Update all relevant tests.
summary: Fixed test event detection so that agent.tool.test.starting and agent.tool.test.ended events are emitted correctly for all languages and frameworks. Added detectCompoundTestKind to handle compound test invocations (go test, npm test, cargo test, etc.) and direct test runner binaries (jest, vitest, pytest, rspec, phpunit, ctest, etc.) to classifyCommandKind. Fixed resolveCursorEvent (beforeShellExecution/afterShellExecution) and resolveWindsurfEvent (pre_run_command/post_run_command) to use resolvePreToolUse/resolvePostToolUse with ToolKindGeneric guard. Added parseTestInfoFromCommand and parseGoTimeoutToSeconds helpers for extracting test filters and timeouts from command strings. Extended extractTestStartingFromInput with command-string fallback. Fixed TestTicketLifecycle_NoManagement pre-existing failure with testSessionIDOverride mechanism for distinct session IDs in tests. Removed stale patch_files_cache.go file.
